qualifier: IL-12 family, IL-10, IL-15/IL-21 with NK cell expansion
name: IL-12 family, IL-10 and IL-15/IL-21 signaling with NK expansion
rationale: All members are IL-12-family (IL-12/23/27/35), IL-10, IL-15/IL-21 cytokine signaling or the NK-cell proliferation and differentiation they drive, distinguishing it from the IL-20/type III interferon and IL-2/7/9 confusables.

name: Cardiac chamber myocardium morphogenesis and trabeculation
rationale: Members concern ventricular and atrial myocardium morphogenesis (trabecular and compact layers, cardiomyocyte development, adult heart), unlike confusables about cardiomyocyte proliferation/regeneration, early heart tube, septum and second heart field, or endocardium.

name: Eicosanoid and pro-resolving lipid mediator synthesis and signaling
rationale: Members are oxygenated polyunsaturated fatty acid mediators (prostaglandins, leukotrienes, HETEs, EETs, lipoxins, resolvins, protectins, maresins), their P450/COX/LOX enzymes and receptors, distinct from coagulation, endocannabinoid, vitamin K and LPA confusables.

name: Psychostimulant reward behavior and dopaminergic transmission
rationale: Members are behavioral and cellular responses to cocaine, amphetamine and nicotine, conditioning and dopamine release/DARPP-32 signaling, unlike confusables centred on ethanol/opioid behavior or dopamine receptor transduction.

name: RUNX target transcription across lineages and HOX clusters
rationale: Members are RUNX1/2/3-regulated gene programs (myeloid, keratinocyte, BCR, interleukin, WNT, estrogen receptor) plus HOX gene clusters, lacking the megakaryocyte/erythroid and granulopoiesis content of the confusables.

qualifier: G protein and arrestin transduction, postsynaptic modulation
name: Dopamine receptor signal transduction and postsynaptic modulation
rationale: Members are dopamine receptor signaling via adenylate cyclase, PLC and beta-arrestin and its postsynaptic and locomotor effects, rather than drug-reward behavior or generic cAMP metabolism in the confusables.

name: Hippo-YAP/TAZ signaling with anoikis and cell death control
rationale: Members are Hippo/YAP-TAZ signaling and cell-density sensing together with anoikis, autophagic cell death and antitumor defense, which the TGF-beta mutant, senescence, PTK6 and AP-2 confusables lack.

name: Selective autophagy and autophagosome/endosome-lysosome fusion
rationale: Members are autophagosome assembly and maturation, selective autophagy (pexophagy, reticulophagy, aggrephagy, mitophagy, CMA, microautophagy) and fusion with lysosomes, unlike confusables on ESCRT/MVB sorting, PINK1-PRKN mitochondrial control or endosome size.

name: Glucagon-cAMP-PKA signaling in islet hormone secretion
rationale: Members cover glucagon receptor/PKA signaling, adenylate cyclase activation and glucose-regulated insulin and glucagon secretion, distinct from the incretin, cholinergic and free fatty acid receptor routes or gluconeogenesis in the confusables.

name: PCNA-dependent DNA synthesis in replication and translesion bypass
rationale: Members are DNA synthesis steps (priming, elongation, polymerase switching, flap removal, translesion polymerases, NER gap filling), distinct from base-excision gap filling, telomere C-strand synthesis and NER incision in the confusables.

qualifier: myoblast proliferation, differentiation and fusion in regeneration
name: Skeletal myoblast differentiation, fusion and regenerative myogenesis
rationale: Members regulate skeletal myoblast proliferation, commitment, differentiation, fusion and satellite-cell-driven regeneration, unlike confusables on satellite cell maintenance, atrophy or extraocular muscle.

name: Proline, glycine and glyoxylate metabolism
rationale: Members are proline synthesis and catabolism, glycine biosynthesis and glyoxylate metabolism, distinct from glutamate/glutamine and urea cycle/ornithine confusables.

name: PLC-IP3-calcium signaling including noncanonical Wnt/Ca2+
rationale: Members concern G protein/PLC-driven inositol phosphate and calcium signaling (LPA/S1P receptors, VEGFR2, Ca2+ pathway), with Wnt/Ca2+ distinguishing it from the eicosanoid GPCR, PKC, cAMP and purinergic confusables.

qualifier: ERBB, ALK, FGFR, PDGFR mutants and drug resistance
name: Oncogenic ERBB, ALK, FGFR and PDGFR mutants and drug resistance
rationale: Members are cancer-associated mutant, amplified or fused ERBB2/EGFR, ALK/LTK, FGFR and PDGFR kinases and their inhibitor resistance, whereas the confusables center on FLT3, KIT and cytokine receptor signaling.

qualifier: cancer mutants, TGFBR3 and RUNX3 targets
name: TGF-beta superfamily SMAD signaling and its cancer mutants
rationale: Members are TGF-beta, BMP, activin and AMH receptor-SMAD signaling, its regulation and cancer mutants, with RUNX3 targets, distinct from the miRNA, MET and Hippo confusables.

name: RHOA/B/C, RHOD/F and RHOG cycles with macropinocytosis
rationale: Members are RHOA/B/C/D/F/G GTPase cycles plus macropinocytosis, pinocytosis, podosome and endosome transport regulation, whereas confusables carry CDC42, RAC, RND and actin-nucleation content.

name: DNA glycosylase damaged-base recognition and excision
rationale: All members are the glycosylase steps that recognize and cleave damaged purines or pyrimidines, unlike confusables covering AP-site processing, gap filling and defective glycosylase variants.

qualifier: sterols, fatty acid elongation and ether lipids
name: Sterol, fatty acid elongation and ether lipid biosynthesis
rationale: Members are cholesterol synthesis (lanosterol, Bloch and Kandutsch-Russell), very-long-chain and polyunsaturated fatty acid elongation and plasmalogen/wax synthesis, distinct from VLCFA beta-oxidation and mevalonate isoprenoid confusables.

name: Thyroid hormone synthesis, H2O2 generation and receptor signaling
rationale: Members cover thyroid hormone generation, transport and receptor responses with the hydrogen peroxide production it requires, unlike confusables on selenium, sulfate/iodide transport or ascorbate.

qualifier: positive regulation in NK and T cells
name: Activation of NK and T cell cytotoxicity
rationale: Members are NK cell signatures and positive regulation of NK and T cell cytotoxicity and NK cytokine production, whereas confusables carry inhibitory KIR/MHC class Ib and negative regulation content.

qualifier: erythrocyte gas exchange and Rh glycoproteins
name: Erythrocyte gas exchange and Rh-glycoprotein ammonium transport
rationale: Members are erythrocyte O2/CO2/NO transport and Rh-glycoprotein ammonium and CO2 transport, distinct from Rh antigen biosynthesis, iron/heme handling and bicarbonate transport confusables.

core: Class I cytokine hormone receptor signaling
name: Growth hormone, prolactin and leptin receptor signaling
rationale: Members are GH, prolactin and leptin receptor (JAK-STAT) signaling with IGF and body growth regulation, unlike thyroid, appetite and glucocorticoid confusables.

qualifier: HSF1 heat shock and mitochondrial import
name: HSF1 heat shock response, chaperonin folding and mitochondrial import
rationale: Members cover HSF1 activation and attenuation, chaperonin and ER folding, refolding, UPRmt and mitochondrial matrix import, distinct from stress granule, aggrephagy and nitrosative-stress confusables.

name: Nitric oxide synthase regulation and NO-cGMP signal transduction
rationale: All members are NO synthase regulation or NO/NO-cGMP signal transduction, whereas confusables concern vascular smooth muscle contraction and blood pressure outcomes.

qualifier: ligand lipidation, SMO activation and GLI processing
name: Hedgehog ligand lipidation, SMO activation and GLI processing
rationale: Members are Hedgehog ligand autoprocessing and palmitoylation, release, SMO activation, ciliary localization and GLI processing/degradation, distinct from the Wnt and Notch confusables.
